facts.text: "We watch her house all night and eat in the car. It gets personal fast."
facts.why: Chris Lecce never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Chris Lecce, so it reads as a film line. A real Lecce line is much shorter.

vibe.verdict: The stakeout snacks are on the money, but a chalkboard lunch truck is an odd home for two cops in a parked car.
